what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-3: grey pins go into the panel, a grey beam is pressed over the two blue pins, then the 15-hole beam and the L-beam are laid on and locked by the blue pins. A 1:1 box confirms the 15-hole beam.
where_everything_is_after: a long black side beam with a panel, an L-beam end and two blue pins is ready to be fitted next

why.problem_solved: Builds the long side piece that rides along the cab frame.
why.why_these_parts: A 15-hole beam spans the whole side; the panel and L-beam add stiffness and mounting points.
why.sets_up_for_later: Step 32 and 33 add pins and a small yellow part to the model before this piece is fitted.

review_note: Exact holes are not countable from the picture. The small grey part in the box is read as a thick 1 x 2 beam (43857); it could be a different grey part.
